title: Audit, Fee, Credit Hold and Wind-Down Terms by Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade
content:
Unannounced inventory audits, the fees billed on the Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line, the sold-out-of-trust count that places a line on credit hold, the cure period for a unit not found at audit, and the payoff period once a line enters wind-down are fixed per Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade as follows.

## Audit and sold-out-of-trust terms

| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade | Calendar days between unannounced audits | Fee per audit (USD) | Fee per unit found sold out of trust (USD) | Sold-out-of-trust units on one audit that place the line on credit hold | Business days to produce a unit not found at audit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 | 30 | 175 | 250 | 1 | 1 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 | 45 | 175 | 250 | 1 | 2 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 | 60 | 150 | 250 | 2 | 2 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 | 90 | 125 | 250 | 2 | 3 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 | 90 | 100 | 250 | 3 | 3 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 | 120 | 0 | 250 | 3 | 3 |

## Late interest, hold release and wind-down terms

| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade | Late interest fee, percent of the unpaid interest | Minimum late interest fee (USD) | Hold released only after every sold-out-of-trust unit is paid in collected funds | Calendar days after wind-down begins by which every unit must be paid off |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 | 5.0 | 50 | Yes | 30 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 | 5.0 | 50 | Yes | 30 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 | 5.0 | 50 | Yes | 45 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 | 5.0 | 50 | Yes | 45 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 | 5.0 | 50 | Yes | 60 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 | 5.0 | 50 | Yes | 60 |

## Terms as defined for these tables

- **Audit frequency**: calendar days between unannounced floorplan audits.
- **Audit fee**: fee per audit, in USD.
- **Sold-out-of-trust fee**: fee per unit found sold out of trust, in USD.
- **Credit hold threshold**: sold-out-of-trust units on one audit that place the line on credit hold, as a count.
- **Missing-unit cure period**: business days to produce a unit not found at audit before it is treated as sold out of trust.
- **Late interest fee**: fee on interest billed but unpaid after its due date, as a percent of the unpaid interest.
- **Late interest fee minimum**: minimum late interest fee, in USD.
- **Cash payoff for hold release**: whether a credit hold is released only after every sold-out-of-trust unit is paid in collected funds.
- **Wind-down payoff period**: calendar days after wind-down begins by which every unit must be paid off.

## Reading the tables

An audit fee of 0 USD on Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 means its audits are billed nothing. The credit hold threshold is a count of units found sold out of trust on one audit: on Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4, one such unit on an audit leaves the count below 2, while two such units on the same audit reach it.
